newsitem.title: USA: UDS Corp seen shutting units for maintenance.
newsitem.headline: UDS Corp seen shutting units for maintenance.

text.p: Ultramar Diamond Shamrock Corp (UDS) said Monday a brief power outage forced the early maintenance shutdown of two units at its Wilmington, Calif., refinery over the weekend.
"The units were in the process of starting down when we had the power (loss)," said a trader familiar with the facility.
The units, a coker and crude processor, will remain shut the rest of the week for maintenance work scheduled before the incident.
The refinery's sole coker has a capacity of 22,000 barrels-per-day (bpd) and the shut crude unit is one of two process which handle 68,000 bpd of crude.
Distillate and production of blending components will be reduced "to some degree," the trader said.
